name: zrndr_set_perspective_texture_far_z
description: zRndr::SetPerspectiveTextureFarZ stores the reciprocal far-Z value for perspective texture correction when the argument is nonzero.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4904a0 validates a stdcall leaf function that compares the stack float argument against 0.0, skips the store when the comparison is equal, otherwise divides 1.0f by farZ and stores the float result in g_perspectiveTextureFarZInv before returning with callee cleanup.
The native smoke verifies zero preserves the previous cached reciprocal and positive and negative nonzero far-Z values update g_perspectiveTextureFarZInv to the expected reciprocal.
The data gate is accepted by zrndr_perspective_texture_setter_data: gRndr_PerspTextureFarZInv and the adjacent perspective texture global set all report zero unmasked data-byte mismatches.

VC5SP3 byte verification now passes for 0x4904a0 through zrndr_perspective_texture_setters with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking, 12 relocation-masked bytes, and 12 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4904a0 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 12 relocation-masked bytes and 12 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 36, VC object symbol size 48.
